decisions.reason: The net price display plugin sits close to the firm's core shop-extension expertise, and in-house R&D lets the firm interpret early feedback and refine it at low cost.
The ERP interface builds directly on the firm's integration and development know-how and supports its end-to-end and multichannel strategy, so the firm can readily assimilate learning to improve it.
Price comparison tracking fits the firm's analytics and marketing competence, though some risk of consolidation exists because several similar variants were launched.
This tracking variant leverages existing related knowledge and needs little upkeep, but as a near-duplicate it could be merged or retired if its shop platform loses relevance.
